Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class BarColumnChecks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.BarColumnChecks
public final class BarColumnChecks extends Object
Bar support and collapse in a live level that does not touch loader-native automation directly: item validity, grounding at the bottom of a column, footprint overlap deciding support across the alternating layer orientations, and player extraction dropping what it unsupports. Capability/Transfer-API-facing tests, and Forge's event-bus-driven protection test, stay in each loader's own BarColumnGameTests.
